تسامحت (form VI)

# تَسَامَحْتَ (tasāmaḥta) /ta.saː.maħ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَسَامَحَ (tasāmaḥa)
# تَسَامَحْتِ (tasāmaḥti) /ta.saː.maħ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَسَامَحَ (tasāmaḥa)
# تَسَامَحَتْ (tasāmaḥat) /ta.saː.ma.ħat/: third-person fem
